notes: ἐν αἷς is one aligned unit for the portmanteau 'wherein' under rule 35, headed on the relative, not noncompositional.
δυνάμεις is headed on 'mighty' here and in 11:21 and 11:23, following the ASV's own marginal gloss 'powers', 'works' being the generic completion under rule 66. Heading on 'works' remains defensible.
αἱ is unrepresented under rule 20, αὐτοῦ being free to take 'his'.
